final: WITH driver_qual_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) as qual_count FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), avg_qual_count AS (SELECT AVG(qual_count) as avg_count FROM driver_qual_counts) SELECT dqc.driverId, dqc.qual_count, CAST(dqc.qual_count AS FLOAT) / aqc.avg_count as ratio FROM driver_qual_counts dqc CROSS JOIN avg_qual_count aqc ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
